title: Local Git commit catalogue
description: Rebuildable metadata index. Activity dates use Asia/Bangkok. Counts include separate clones and retained rewritten history.

recent.title: Recent commits
recent.sql: SELECT repository, hash, committer_date, author_name, subject, reachability FROM v_recent_commits ORDER BY unixepoch(committer_date) DESC LIMIT 100

daily.title: Daily activity
daily.sql: SELECT * FROM v_daily_activity ORDER BY activity_date DESC LIMIT 90

search.title: Search commits
search.sql: SELECT r.name AS repository, c.hash, c.committer_date, c.author_name, c.subject FROM commit_search JOIN commits c ON c.rowid=commit_search.rowid JOIN repositories r ON r.id=c.repository_id WHERE commit_search MATCH :query ORDER BY bm25(commit_search), unixepoch(c.committer_date) DESC LIMIT 100
